message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on the fact: The defendant, as legal representative of a company, failed to declare and pay tax on sales, evading tax of 322,236.41 RMB. Paid some VAT and penalty, but remaining tax not paid. This is tax evasion. Under Chinese criminal law, the crime is "偷税漏税罪" (Tax evasion). Also possibly "逃税罪"? The official term is "偷税漏税罪" (Tax evasion). Could also be "逃税罪" but the criminal law uses "偷税漏税罪". So list that.

Any other crimes? Possibly "拒不缴纳税款罪"? Actually there is "拒不缴纳税款罪" (Refusal to pay tax) but the fact is evasion, not refusal after notice. The main is tax evasion.

Thus answer: [偷税漏税罪] <eoa>. Use Chinese characters. Use format: [罪名] and <eoa>. They want multiple separated by ';' if multiple. Only one.

Thus final.
